reddit.title: Explore the Five Territories in Provincia's New Conquest Campaign
reddit.body: We're excited to share insights on our latest update, which introduces a new campaign mode in Provincia! In 'Tutorial 2 · Conquest', you'll navigate a home basin and expand your territory through strategic battles. Each of the five territories offers unique rewards, but you'll need to conquer them in a specific order. Ready to dive in? Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/five-territories-beyond-the-basin?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=five-territories-beyond-the-basin

discord.content: Attention Provincia players! We're thrilled to announce the launch of 'Tutorial 2 · Conquest'. This new campaign mode allows you to explore five territories while battling for dominance. The map now features a home basin and fog that lifts as you march forward. Check out the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/five-territories-beyond-the-basin?utm_source=discord&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=five-territories-beyond-the-basin

steam.title: New Conquest Campaign in Provincia!
steam.body: We're excited to announce 'Tutorial 2 · Conquest', where you'll embark on a journey to conquer five distinct territories. Each territory offers unique resources and challenges, and you'll need to strategize your attacks carefully. Start your campaign today and explore the new features! Learn more here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/five-territories-beyond-the-basin?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=five-territories-beyond-the-basin
